descriptionByLocale.it:
Il dolore neuropatico è una condizione di salute secondaria grave e debilitante dopo la lesione del midollo spinale (SCI). Probabilmente comporta interazioni cerebrali-spinali anormali, tra cui ipereccitabilità spinale e modulazione del dolore alterata nel cervello, ma le prove negli esseri umani sono ancora mancanti a causa della mancanza di protocolli di imaging per misurare l'attività del midollo spinale. In questo studio multicentro (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), studieremo il dolore neuropatico in SCI utilizzando cervello e midollo spinale fMRI. Dopo aver istituito e convalidato un nuovo protocollo fMRI del cavo lumbosacrale attraverso i due centri, valuteremo la sensibilizzazione spinale e l'attività cerebrale anormale legata al dolore neuropatico nelle persone con SCI. descriptionByLocale.en:
Neuropathic pain is a major, debilitating secondary health condition after spinal cord injury (SCI). It likely involves abnormal brain–spinal interactions, including spinal hyperexcitability and altered pain modulation in the brain, but evidence in humans is still missing due to the lack of imaging protocols to measure spinal cord activity.

In this multicentre study (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), we will investigate neuropathic pain in SCI using brain and spinal cord fMRI. After setting up and validating a novel lumbosacral cord fMRI protocol across the two centres, we will assess spinal sensitisation and abnormal brain activity linked to neuropathic pain in individuals with SCI. As part of the PhD thesis, the student is expected to take an active role in all the aspects of the project, including study conceptualization and design, preparation of the ethical application, data collection and analysis, and publication of the results. Aufgaben: • Contribution to study conceptualization and design • Writing and submission of study documents for approval by ethics committees or authorities • Enrolment of study participants, data collection, analysis and interpretation • Writing and submission of publications in high impact, peer-reviewed journals • Presentation of research findings at national and international conferences Anforderungen: • Master degree in neuroscience, psychology, biology, biomedical engineering or similar, acceptable for matriculation at a Swiss University (Bologna compatible) • Interest in neuroimaging methods, with particular focus on functional MRI • Knowledge in Matlab and/or RStudio • Willingness to work with patients in clinical settings • Proactive, good communication skills and attitude to team-work • Excellent knowledge in both German and English, mother tongue German is preferred • Willingness to travel regularly between Zurich and Nottwil (Lucerne) Wir bieten: You can expect attractive employment conditions as well as numerous other advantages. Look forward to meaningful work in a modern work environment, flexible working times and various further training opportunities. Come and join us and experience our unique spirit. The mission of SPF is sustainably improving the situation of people with spinal cord injury (SCI) through interdisciplinary, clinical and Community-based research on a national and international level. Specific areas of its comprehensive research include functioning, mobility, social integration, equality of opportunity, self-determination, quality of life, health services provision as well as epidemiology and statistical methods. SPF is an university research institution recognized and promoted by the Swiss federal government and the cantons and an active link to academic and industrial research and development at the national and international levels.

Nach der Einrichtung und Validierung eines neuartigen lumbosakralen fMRI-Protokolls in den beiden Zentren werden wir die Wirbelsäulensensibilisierung und abnormale Gehirnaktivität im Zusammenhang mit neuropathischen Schmerzen bei Personen mit SCI bewerten. **Mitarbeiter*in Peer-Beratung presso la Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe offre l'opportunità di contribuire attivamente al sostegno e all'inclusione delle persone con disabilità motoria. In questa posizione, lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con un team multidisciplinare per fornire consulenza esperta e supporto basato su esperienze personali ai membri della comunità.

Il ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione delle sfide e delle necessità delle persone con disabilità motoria, nonché una forte capacità di comunicazione e empatia. Sei responsabile di organizzare incontri di consulenza, fornire supporto individuale e partecipare a progetti che promuovono l'autonomia e la qualità della vita.

Valori fondamentali:
- Empatia e comprensione: Essere in grado di comprendere e rispondere alle esigenze delle persone con disabilità.
- Competenza professionale: Possedere una solida conoscenza delle tematiche legate alla disabilità motoria.
- Collaborazione: Lavora in modo efficace in un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e collaborativo.

Il ruolo è ideale per chi desidera combinare la propria esperienza personale con quella professionale per fare una differenza tangibile nella vita delle persone con disabilità.

Informazioni aggiuntive:
- Il ruolo è parte del progetto di inclusione e supporto della Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.
- Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con un team di professionisti e volontari.
- L'ambiente di lavoro è dinamico e orientato al supporto comunitario.

Job Title
Peer Counselor at Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe in Nottwil (6207, LU), Switzerland

Location
Nottwil (LU)

Description
Please submit your application via the Umantis Career Portal of Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.

Peer Counselor at Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe offers the opportunity to actively contribute to the support and inclusion of individuals with motor disabilities. In this role, you will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team to provide expert peer counseling and support based on personal experiences to community members.

The position requires a deep understanding of the challenges and needs of individuals with motor disabilities, as well as strong communication skills and empathy. You will be responsible for organizing counseling sessions, providing individual support, and participating in projects that promote autonomy and quality of life.

Core Values:
- Empathy and Understanding: Ability to comprehend and address the needs of individuals with disabilities.
- Professional Competence: Solid knowledge of disability-related themes, particularly motor disabilities.
- Collaboration: Work effectively in an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

This role is ideal for those who wish to combine personal experience with professional expertise to make a tangible difference in the lives of individuals with disabilities.

Additional Information:
- This role is part of the inclusion and support project of Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.
- You will work closely with a team of professionals and volunteers.
- The work environment is dynamic and community-focused.

To apply, submit your application through the Umantis Career Portal of Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.

Notes:
- The position requires good knowledge of English (written and spoken) in addition to your native language.
- The position is full-time.

For further information or any questions, please contact the Human Resources representative of Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.

Inclusion and Diversity: Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion. We are proud to be an inclusive organization and welcome applications from all candidates who meet the role requirements.

Description
Veuillez soumettre votre candidature via le portail de carrière Umantis de Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.

Conseiller·ère en Soutien Pair à la Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe offre l’opportunité de contribuer activement au soutien et à l’inclusion des personnes en situation de handicap moteur. Dans ce poste, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire pour fournir un accompagnement expert et un soutien basé sur des expériences personnelles aux membres de la communauté.

Le poste nécessite une compréhension approfondie des défis et des besoins des personnes en situation de handicap moteur, ainsi que de solides compétences en communication et en empathie. Vous serez responsable de l’organisation de séances de conseil, du soutien individuel et de la participation à des projets visant à promouvoir l’autonomie et la qualité de vie.

Valeurs Fondamentales:
- Empathie et compréhension: Capacité à comprendre et répondre aux besoins des personnes en situation de handicap.
- Compétence professionnelle: Connaissance solide des thèmes liés au handicap moteur.
- Collaboration: Travail efficace dans un environnement de travail inclusif et collaboratif.

Ce poste est idéal pour ceux qui souhaitent combiner leur expérience personnelle avec leur expertise professionnelle pour apporter une différence tangible dans la vie des personnes en situation de handicap.

Informations Complémentaires:
- Ce poste fait partie du projet d’inclusion et de soutien de la Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.
- Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe de professionnels et de bénévoles.
- L’environnement de travail est dynamique et axé sur le soutien communautaire.

Pour postuler, envoyez votre candidature via le portail de carrière Umantis de Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.

Notes:
- Le poste nécessite une bonne connaissance du français (écrit et parlé) en plus de la langue maternelle.
- Le poste est à temps plein.

Pour toute information supplémentaire ou question, contactez le responsable des ressources humaines de la Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.

Inclusion et diversité: La Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe est engagée à promouvoir la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous sommes fiers d’être une organisation inclusive et accueillons favorablement les candidatures de tous les candidats qui répondent aux exigences du poste.

Beraterinnen und Berater für Unterstützte Kommunikation oder elektronische Hilfsmittel bei Active Communication Unsere Berater*innen Unterstützte Kommunikation beraten und betreuen unsere Kund*innen und deren Umfeld vor Ort, um eine massgenschneiderte Versorgung im Bereich Kommunikation zu gewährleisten. Sie bringen eine Ausbildung im sozialen Bereich (z.B. Sozialpädagog*in o.ä.) mit. Bei der Beratung für elektronische Hilfsmittel liegt der Fokus auf der nachhaltigen Versorgung mit elektronischen Hilfsmitteln, Computeranpassungen und Umfeldkontrolle. Grundlage dafür ist eine technische Grundbildung (Elektroniker*in, Informatiker*in, Elektriker*in) oder eine Grundbildung im sozialen Bereich (FaBe, FaGe) mit guten technischen Fähigkeiten. Unsere Berater*innen sind unterwegs in der ganzen Schweiz. Initiativbewerbung einreichen

Rettungssanitäter*in HF und einer pädagogischen Ausbildung im Umfang von mindestens einem SVEB-Zertifikat Ausbildner*in oder sind erfahrene dipl.
